types.description: An app deployed as one Cloudflare Worker, with or without static assets, in one environment. Takes every deployment.base attribute (@app, @environment, @domains, @branch, @secrets, and value.* children) and adds the Worker's own. The facts every environment shares belong on an abstract deployment.worker that each environment's deployment extends; the environment's deployment then holds only what differs there. The wrangler.jsonc generator writes the top-level environment and one complete env block per other environment.
types.whenToUse: Each (app, environment) pair that runs as a Cloudflare Worker.

children.name: script
children.description: The Worker's name on Cloudflare. Absent means the app's name. In an env block the name is `<top-level name>-<environment>` (Wrangler's own default) unless this deployment's @script differs from the top level's: two environments never deploy over one Worker.

children.name: main
children.description: The Worker's entry module from the repository root (`src/index.ts`). Absent for a Worker that only serves assets.

children.name: compatibilityDate
children.description: The Workers runtime compatibility date (`2026-07-01`).

children.name: compatibilityFlags
children.description: Workers runtime compatibility flags (`nodejs_compat`).

children.name: workersDev
children.description: Whether the Worker is also served on its workers.dev subdomain. Absent leaves Wrangler's default (served).

children.name: assetsBinding
children.description: The binding the Worker reads its static assets through (`ASSETS`). The assets are the directory of the app's build.static. Absent: the Worker reads none itself.

children.name: notFound
children.description: What a request that matches no asset gets: single-page-application (the index page), 404-page (the nearest 404.html) or none (a 404, or the Worker). Cloudflare's own names.

children.name: workerFirst
children.description: true: the Worker runs before the assets for every request. Not with @workerFirstPaths.

children.name: workerFirstPaths
children.description: The route patterns the Worker runs before the assets for (`/api/*`); every other request is served from the assets first. Not with @workerFirst.

children.name: jobs
children.description: The app.job nodes this Worker runs on their @schedule (its scheduled handler), as `System.job`. Each must resolve to an app.job with a @schedule; each schedule is a cron trigger.

children.name: tokenSecret
children.description: The name, in the vault, of the narrow Cloudflare API token the deploy scripts use for this Worker. The scripts map it to CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN and unset the global-key variables. The vault entry CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID sits beside it.

children.name: tokenVault
children.description: The vault (a vault.* of the config pack, by name) whose scope for this environment holds @tokenSecret and CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID. Absent means the @secrets vault.

children.name: extra
children.description: A JSON object of Wrangler configuration keys this pack does not model, copied into the environment's block as written. The escape hatch: a key the generator writes itself is refused.

types.description: An app deployed as a Cloudflare Pages site in one environment: the directory of its build.static, uploaded by `wrangler pages deploy`. Takes every deployment.base attribute; @branch is the branch the upload is recorded on (the project's production branch, or a preview branch).
types.whenToUse: Each (app, environment) pair that ships as a Cloudflare Pages site.

children.name: project
children.description: The Pages project's name.

children.name: tokenSecret
children.description: The name, in the vault, of the narrow Cloudflare API token the deploy scripts use for this site (Pages Write). The scripts map it to CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN and unset the global-key variables. The vault entry CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID sits beside it.

children.name: tokenVault
children.description: The vault (a vault.* of the config pack, by name) whose scope for this environment holds @tokenSecret and CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID. Absent means the @secrets vault.

types.description: Abstract Cloudflare binding base: one binding of a Worker, a child of a deployment.worker. Its binding name is the node's name in upper snake case (`rateLimit` is RATE_LIMIT). Not authored directly: a `cloudflare.base` node fails to load (ERR_ABSTRACT_SUBTYPE_AUTHORED).
Where a resource.database the app needs lives on D1 in this environment. Named after the resource.
types.whenToUse: Each D1 database a Worker binds.

children.name: databaseName
children.description: The D1 database's name.

children.name: databaseId
children.description: The D1 database's id.

children.name: migrationsDir
children.description: The directory of its migrations, from the repository root, for `wrangler d1 migrations`.

types.description: Where a resource.keyvalue the app needs lives in Workers KV in this environment. Named after the resource.
types.whenToUse: Each KV namespace a Worker binds.

children.name: namespaceId
children.description: The KV namespace's id.

types.description: Where a resource.bucket the app needs lives in R2 in this environment. Named after the resource.
types.whenToUse: Each R2 bucket a Worker binds.

children.name: bucketName
children.description: The R2 bucket's name.

types.description: Where a resource.queue the app sends to lives in Cloudflare Queues in this environment. Named after the resource.
types.whenToUse: Each queue a Worker produces messages on.

children.name: queue
children.description: The queue's name.

types.description: A Workers rate limiting binding: at most @limit calls per key in @period seconds.
types.whenToUse: Each rate limiter a Worker checks.

children.name: namespaceId
children.description: The limiter's namespace id, unique in the account (`1001`).

children.name: limit
children.description: The calls allowed per key in one period.

children.name: period
children.description: The period in seconds: 10 or 60, the only two Cloudflare accepts.
